# Get all liked songs (paginate) and the current queue
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)

    page_index += 1

print("Liked song IDs:", [s['song_id'] for s in liked_songs])
print("Queue song IDs:", [s['song_id'] for s in queue])
